operators.name: relational_operator_replacement
operators.description: Replace < with <=, > with >=, == with !=, in with not in, not in with in, is with is not, is not with is.

operators.name: logical_connector_replacement
operators.description: Replace and with or and or with and.

operators.name: condition_negation
operators.description: Remove a unary not (for example, `not x` becomes `x`).

operators.name: statement_deletion
operators.description: Delete one statement from a changed line set.

operators.name: return_value_replacement
operators.description: Replace a return expression with None or a zero value of the same type.

operators.name: value_default_replacement
operators.description: Replace a default argument with None or an empty container.

operators.name: break_continue_replacement
operators.description: Replace break with continue and continue with break.

semantics: Effective high-path bar is 100% (0 survivors dominates). kill_ratio is informative-only and cannot pass a high-path survivor; a single survivor on a changed high-path line fails even when score >= threshold. This unifies the former contradictory ratio comfort with the max_survivors_in_high_path=0 bar.

fail_closed.note: Missing score, threshold, or 0 mutants must not PASS via 0<0. The gate_run checker owned by another agent must emit MUTATION_MISSING_SCORE / MUTATION_MISSING_THRESHOLD / MUTATION_NO_MUTANTS findings; see gate_run_patch_pending.

cap_enforcement.rule: The budget is dealt round-robin across mutatable hunks: every such hunk gets min_mutants_per_hunk before any hunk gets a second mutant. MUTATION_TRUNCATED fails only when the budget starves a mutatable hunk below its minimum. Truncating above the minimums is recorded in evidence (truncated:true) and does not fail.
cap_enforcement.reason: Round-robin allocation makes starvation a real cap failure instead of a sort-order artefact; comment-only and relocated-only hunks are ineligible and never demand a mutant.

typescript.note: python-only confirmed, TS N/A — delivery scope files/ + scripts/ has 0 *.ts/*.tsx/*.js changed files (vendored scratchpad/node_modules excluded); no TypeScript operators exist. NOT_APPLICABLE is fail-closed on 0 mutants (BLOCK, never PASS); a future TS engine would need its own operators and min_mutants_per_hunk guard.

scope.exclude_moved_lines_note: A statement whose every added line moved verbatim from the removed side is a relocation, not new behaviour. Mutating it would score the pre-existing test suite, not the change. A moved line whose text changed is mutated normally.

test_selection.wide_note: Wide runs only for mutants the added tests did not kill: test files for the changed app whose name matches the module stem, then tests.py, then the rest, capped. This is what lets a refactor's moved branches be judged by the tests that already covered them without paying the app-suite cost on every mutant.

timeout_note: Total mutant budget for one check run. Tiered selection keeps most mutants on the fast added-test set, so the wide covering set is paid only for survivors.
